title: WaitLens: Temporal VLM-Based Adaptive Waiting for Industrial GUI Testing Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.32482v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Improving the efficiency of GUI testing agents is important for industrial deployment. Beyond LLM inference, fixed waiting between consecutive interactions introduces substantial overhead. Our industrial study reveals that fixed waiting accounts for 42.3% of the time within the sampled interaction intervals, comparable to the 54.8% spent on model calls. Moreover, 62.9% of the waiting time is spent after the GUI has already finished loading. Although prior studies have proposed adaptive waiting strategies, their reliance on app-specific data or platform-specific information limits their applicability across diverse industrial environments. To this end, we propose WaitLens, which fine-tunes a lightweight VLM on GUI loading trajectories annotated with waiting end times. We introduce temporal resampling to construct diverse training examples, enabling the model to learn varying GUI loading behaviors from temporal observations. Experiments sh

translated_title: WaitLens：面向工业GUI测试智能体的基于时序视觉语言模型的自适应等待机制
translated_abstract: 提升GUI测试智能体的效率对工业部署至关重要。除了大语言模型（LLM）推理之外，连续交互之间的固定等待也带来了大量开销。我们的工业研究显示，固定等待占采样交互区间时间的42.3%，与模型调用所消耗的54.8%相当。此外，62.9%的等待时间发生在GUI已经完成加载之后。尽管先前的研究提出了自适应等待策略，但它们对特定应用数据或平台特定信息的依赖限制了其在多样化工业环境中的适用性。为此，我们提出WaitLens，它在标注了等待结束时间的GUI加载轨迹上微调一个轻量级视觉语言模型（VLM）。我们引入时间重采样来构建多样化的训练样本，使模型能够从时间观测中学习不同的GUI加载行为。实验结果表明……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: WaitLens通过在标注等待结束时间的GUI加载轨迹上微调轻量级视觉语言模型，并引入时间重采样构建多样化训练数据，实现了适用于多种工业环境的自适应等待策略，显著减少了占交互时间高达42.3%的固定等待开销。
en_tdlr: WaitLens fine-tunes a lightweight temporal VLM on GUI loading trajectories annotated with waiting end times and leverages temporal resampling to construct diverse training examples, enabling adaptive waiting that generalizes across industrial environments and substantially reduces the fixed-waiting overhead that accounts for 42.3% of interaction time.
